label: Cursor
instructions: Your own file-writing tool (Write) is turned off here: every write with it is refused, and asking does not turn it on. To create or change a file, run a shell command that writes it (a heredoc such as cat > name <<'EOF' ... EOF, or a short script); a shell command asks the person first. When Write refuses a write, write the file with a shell command instead: never stop at that refusal or answer without the file. When the person denies a shell command, that is their answer: do not ask again for the same write; stop and say what you could not do.

refusals.words: your Cursor team administrator has disabled headless Cursor CLI usage, so AgentRun does not run Cursor on this key; ask them to allow it in Cursor's team settings
